battle.name: 白瑜娑起義
battle.brief: 大業九年（613）正月，隋煬帝下詔徵天下兵集涿郡、募民為驍果之際，靈武賊帥白瑜娑劫掠牧馬，北連突厥，隴右多被其患，朝廷稱之「奴賊」。卡面斯巴達長矛屬公元前八世紀希臘工藝，與本役相隔逾千年，不在此役現場；隋軍步卒用鐵矛長槊與環首刀，叛眾以遊騎劫掠為主。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 白瑜娑起義是隋朝末年西北邊地的一次邊民叛亂。交戰的一方是隋朝中央與靈州、涼州、朔方一帶的邊軍及郡縣武裝；另一方是以白瑜娑為首、聚眾為盜的「奴賊」。《資治通鑑》卷一百八十二記大業九年正月「靈武賊帥白瑜娑劫掠牧馬，北連突厥，隴右多被其患，謂之『奴賊』」，這是白瑜娑之名見於史籍最核心的一條。隋朝方面的指揮體系如此運作：煬帝自大業七年起兩度征討高句麗，大業九年正月又下詔「徵天下兵集涿郡」，「始募民為驍果」，並「修遼東古城以貯軍糧」，精銳主力盡數東調；靈州、涼州、朔方一帶是隋的西北邊防重地，分布著軍府、屯田與牧馬之場，邊軍由郡縣與鎮戍分層管轄，但實際留守的只有地方團練與臨時徵發的人眾。叛軍方面沒有固定編制，也沒有國號，靠流動劫掠維繫，白瑜娑以「賊帥」自居，向北與突厥往來，藉其馬匹與騷擾作為外援；隴右各州郡屢遭其患，朝廷則以蔑稱「奴賊」指稱這類逃奴、逃戶、逃兵糾眾為盜的武裝。整場衝突其實是隋末全國性民變的一個西翼節點：同一卷記載的山東、河北一帶已有王薄、孟海公、張金稱、郝孝德、孫宣雅等各聚眾攻剽，多者十餘萬、少者數萬人，隋廷的處境是腹背受敵。
countriesEn: The rising of Bai Yusa was a frontier revolt in the north-west of the Sui empire. On one side stood the Sui court together with the frontier garrisons and county levies of Lingzhou, Liangzhou and the Shuofang belt; on the other stood the so-called slave-bandits gathered under the bandit chief Bai Yusa. The Zhizhi Tongjian, volume 182, records under the first month of the ninth year of Dayi (613): 'the rebel chief at Lingwu, Bai Yusa, plundered the grazing herds, connected himself with the Turks to the north, and the Longyou region suffered much from his raids; the court called them slave-bandits.' That single line is the core of everything history preserves about Bai Yusa. On the Sui side the chain of command ran as follows: Emperor Yang had campaigned against Goguryeo twice since 607, and in the first month of 613 he again ordered that troops from everywhere in the empire be assembled at Zhuojun, 'began to recruit men as xiaoguo', and 'repaired the old forts in Liaodong to store military grain'; the trained heart of the army was therefore drawn eastward in full. Lingzhou, Liangzhou and the Shuofang belt were the strategic north-west of the dynasty, dotted with military offices, tuntian fields and horse pastures, and the frontier was held by a layered command of prefectures, counties and small garrisons — but what actually remained on the spot were only local militia and hastily conscripted men. The rebels had no fixed establishment and no state title; they lived by mobile plunder, and Bai Yusa styled himself a bandit chief, dealing with the Turks to the north and drawing on them for horses and for diversions behind the governor's lines. The prefectures of Longyou suffered repeatedly, and the court dismissed such bands of runaway slaves, runaway households and deserters as slave-bandits. In the wider frame this rising was the western wing of the general revolt that shook the Sui: the same volume records that in Shandong and Hebei leaders such as Wang Bo, Meng Haigong, Zhang Jincheng, Hao Xiaode and Sun Xuanya had already gathered bands of plunderers, some numbering more than a hundred thousand and others several thousand, leaving the court beset on every front.
people: 白瑜娑本人留下的文字極少。《資治通鑑》只稱他為「靈武賊帥」，未記其出身、籍貫與年歲，也沒有交代他起兵的年月與眾數；《隋書》與《北史》同樣未為他立傳，其生年、去向與部眾的下落只能存疑，其名在後世抄本中亦見異寫，諸說並存。與這場邊事同時出現在相關記載中的隋廷人物包括：煬帝楊廣，正是他在大業九年正月下詔徵天下兵集涿郡、募民為驍果、修遼東古城貯軍糧，使西部邊州與主力大軍同時空虛；左翊衛大將軍宇文述兩度統軍征高句麗，兵敗柳水，徵役與折損在朝野造成極大震動；齊郡丞張須陀是隋廷少數能以郡兵作戰的將領，先後在泰山、臨邑擊破王薄、孟讓等眾；刑部尚書衛文升奉命輔代王侑留守西京，民部尚書樊子蓋輔越王侗留守東都，可見朝廷在兩京收得緊，西部邊州卻無兵可遣。與白瑜娑亂事性質最為相近的，是大業九年夏楊玄感在黎陽起兵，旬日之間眾至數十萬，響應者多為奴婢、屯田與府戶；這說明「奴賊」並非孤立事件，而是隋朝募兵、括戶與律法高壓下的普遍現象。納言蘇威於大業十二年五月直言：「往日租賦丁役，今皆何在！豈非其人皆化為盜乎！」又指出「昔在雁門，許罷征遼，今復征發，賊何由息」。至隋亡前夕，靈武、榆林、平涼、安定諸郡於武德元年正月先後遣使請命李淵，白瑜娑所擾動的邊州最終隨隋室崩解而轉歸新朝。
peopleEn: Almost nothing is left of Bai Yusa himself. The Zhizhi Tongjian calls him nothing more than 'the rebel chief at Lingwu'; it gives no birth, no native place, no age, and it neither dates the outbreak nor states the size of his following. Neither the Suishu nor the Beishi devotes him a biography, so his years, his fate and the dispersal of his band can only be left open; even the spelling of his name varies in later copies, and the accounts conflict. The Sui figures who appear in the same pages are these: Emperor Yang, whose edict of the first month of 613 — assemble the troops of the realm at Zhuojun, begin recruiting xiaoguo, repair the old forts of Liaodong to store military grain — emptied the western border commands and the field armies at one and the same time; the Left Assistant Guards commander Yuwen Shu, who twice led the Goguryeo campaigns and was broken at Liushui, with the levy and its losses shocking the whole court; the Qizhou assistant magistrate Zhang Xutuo, one of the very few Sui officers able to fight with county troops, who broke Wang Bo at Mount Tai and Meng Rang at Linyi; the Minister of Justice Wei Wensheng, ordered to stay in the western capital with the Prince of Jin, and the Minister of Revenue Fan Zigai, ordered to stay in the eastern capital with the Prince of Yue — the court tightened its grip on the two capitals while the frontier prefectures had no troops to send. Closest in character to Bai Yusa's rising was Yang Xiangan's revolt at Liyang in the summer of 613, which drew tens of thousands within ten days, mostly runaway slaves, tuntian households and registered households; the slave-bandit was therefore not an isolated affair but a general product of Sui recruitment, household-registration surveys and a harsh legal code. In the fifth month of the twelfth year of Dayi the grand preceptor Su Wei said outright: 'Where have the taxes and the corvée of former days gone? Have not all these people turned into bandits?' and added: 'Once at Yanmen it was promised that the eastern war would be called off; now it is levied again — how can the bandits ever end?' On the eve of the dynasty's fall, in the first month of the first year of Wude, the prefectures of Lingwu, Yulin, Pingliang and Anding sent envoys one after another to acknowledge Li Yuan. The border prefectures that Bai Yusa had disturbed thus passed, with the collapse of the Sui, to the new dynasty.
kits: 卡面這件斯巴達長矛（Dory）是公元前八世紀的希臘工藝：兩米長的木杆，前端裝青銅矛頭，槍尾綴銅套以便插地支撐，是希臘方陣最基本也最耐用的一件兵器，設計重點在於成排推鋒時的結構強度與取材的便利。必須說明的是，這件兵器與本役相隔一千四百餘年，既不在靈武，也不在隴右的戰場上；它在本卡中的角色是「同期步兵所持長柄刺擊武器」的原型對照。隋軍步卒在陣中實際依靠的是鐵刃長矛與長槊，配環首刀、方盾與弓箭，射手另用臂弓與蹶張弩；騎兵以馬槊與長刀為主，其中亦有人馬皆甲的具裝騎兵，其坐騎多取自西域與北方牧場，而那正是白瑜娑所劫掠的牧馬所在。攻城與守城的器械包括投石車（砲）、巢車、雲梯、衝車，以及床弩、連弩這類大型弩機。保障方面依賴牛車運糧、渡河與海運的轉運，與「修遼東古城以貯軍糧」這樣的就地囤積並行。白瑜娑一方的裝備則來自劫掠所得：從邊州牧場奪來的馬匹、被徵發的屯田戶手上改作矛柄的農具與柴刀，以及逃奴逃兵隨身帶走的少量衣甲，數量與形制都無法與官軍相比。叛眾以馬為主力的流動戰法，也意味著其機動性完全建立在被奪走的馬匹之上。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card face, the Spartan dory, is an artefact of eighth-century BC Greek craft: a two-metre wooden shaft with a bronze head and a bronze butt-spike that let it be planted in the ground, the most basic and most durable weapon of the Greek phalanx, designed for structural strength in a massed push and for the ease of finding materials. It must be said plainly that this weapon lies more than fourteen centuries away from the present action: it was on no battlefield in Lingwu or in Longyou. Its role on this card is that of the prototype to which the long thrusting weapons of the contemporary infantry correspond. The Sui foot soldier in the line actually relied on iron-tipped spears and long lances, with ring-pommel sabres, rectangular shields and bows, while archers were equipped with hand bows and the powerful drawn crossbow; the cavalry fought with cavalry lances and long sabres, and among them were armoured riders with both man and horse in mail, whose mounts came largely from the pastures of the western regions and the northern steppe — exactly the herds that Bai Yusa was seizing. Siege and defence equipment included the stone-throwing carriage, the siege tower, scaling ladders, battering rams, and heavy crossbows and repeating crossbows. Supply rested on ox-carts hauling grain, on river and sea transport, and on stockpiling in place such as 'repairing the old forts of Liaodong to store military grain'. The equipment of Bai Yusa's band, by contrast, was what plunder could provide: horses taken from the frontier pastures, farm tools and wood.axes from conscripted tuntian households turned into spear shafts, and the few garments and armour that runaway slaves and deserters carried with them — numbers and quality that could not be compared with any government force. A fighting method built around the horse also meant that its mobility rested entirely on animals it had stolen.
tactics: 白瑜娑部沒有可考的要塞與城防，其戰法是典型的流動劫掠：依靠馬匹在河套與黃河上游的牧場之間往返，白日散開放牧兼作警戒，夜裡驅群轉移，遇官軍主力則避走，遇空隙便下手奪馬。這套辦法正好針對隋朝西部邊防的結構性空隙——精銳已被抽調到涿郡與遼東，留在靈州、涼州的只有郡兵、縣兵與臨時徵發的人眾。《資治通鑑》直言「天下承平日久，人不習兵，郡縣吏每與賊戰，望風沮敗」：官軍不是沒有出動，而是普遍在接觸之初便自行潰散；同一段記載裡，只有張須陀憑郡兵屢破王薄、孟讓，說明有效的抵抗須靠將才與精選鋒銳，而不是靠制度性的編制。叛軍在組織上採取流動的「賊帥—渠帥」結構：白瑜娑以首領身分居中，旗下分為若干支，各支由小頭目率領，平日各自劫掠，遇官軍大舉則合流，官軍退去則散為遊騎，難以一次殲滅。對外則以向北結交突厥取得馬匹與情報為要務，「北連突厥」既是《資治通鑑》對其外部聯繫的概括，也說明隋廷的邊疆困境已與北方草原勢力綁在一起。追討方面，隋朝的實際辦法是分區清剿與招撫並行：同一卷記大業九年正月「戊戌，赦天下」，而分郡募兵、臨時清剿的結果往往隨主力東調而不了了之，叛眾於是得以長期游走於隴右與靈州之間。
tacticsEn: Bai Yusa's band had no traceable strongholds and no city walls; its method of war was mobile plunder. Mounted, it moved between the pastures of the Hetao loop and the upper Yellow River, spreading out by day to graze and keep watch, driving the herds on by night, breaking away when it met a government column in force and striking at the herds whenever an opening appeared. The method exploited precisely the structural gap in the Sui's western defence: the trained troops had been drawn off to Zhuojun and Liaodong, and what remained in Lingzhou and Liangzhou were county soldiers, local levies and men conscripted on the spot. The Zhizhi Tongjian states it plainly: 'the realm had been at peace for a long time and the people were unused to arms; whenever the county officers fought the bandits, their hearts failed and they scattered at the first contact.' The government was not inactive, but its formations broke on contact; in the same passage only Zhang Xutuo, with county troops, repeatedly defeated Wang Bo and Meng Rang, which shows that effective resistance depended on an able commander and a picked vanguard rather than on any institutional system. Organisationally the rebels used a fluid structure of bandit chief and band leaders: Bai Yusa held the centre, beneath him a number of separate bands, each led by a small chief, plundering on their own by day, joining up when a large government force moved against them and dispersing into free-ranging riders once it withdrew, so that they could never be destroyed in one action. Outwardly, the priority was to deal with the Turks to the north for horses and for intelligence; 'connected with the Turks to the north' is the Tongjian's summary of that external link, and it also shows that the court's frontier difficulties had become bound to the powers of the northern steppe. In pursuit the Sui combined regional sweeps with offers of pardon: the same volume records, in the first month of 613, 'on the day of wu-hai, an amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm', and the results of locally recruited squadrons and sporadic sweeps were repeatedly nullified as the main army was pulled eastward, so that the rebels could roam the Longyou and Lingzhou regions for years.
data: 可徵信的數字多來自《資治通鑑》關於隋末的記載，白瑜娑本人的兵員、戰損與活動年份則幾近空白，因此只能就框架作說明，不作臆測。與本役同月相鄰的數據包括：大業九年正月丁丑「詔徵天下兵集涿郡」，「始募民為驍果」，「修遼東古城以貯軍糧」；同月戊戌「赦天下」；三月濟陰孟海公起為盜，「保據周橋，眾至數萬」；同期山東、河北諸賊帥「各聚眾攻剽，多者十餘萬，少者數萬人」；齊郡丞張須陀以郡兵擊破王薄於泰山下，又追擊破之於臨邑。此外，征遼的敗績在史書中以「士卒死者十四五」記載，比例高到朝野震動；大業十二年五月，蘇威以「其人皆化為盜」形容亂源；同年甄翟兒眾十萬寇太原，潘長文敗死；大業末年平涼「奴賊數萬」圍扶風，「數月不下」，賊軍食盡；武德元年正月，榆林、靈武、平涼、安定諸郡皆遣使請命李淵。至於白瑜娑一眾的具體人數、所占地盤與戰績，正史未載，諸說並存，本卡不列任何估算數字。
dataEn: The figures that can be relied on come from the Tongjian's account of the late Sui, while the numbers for Bai Yusa himself — strength, losses, years of activity — are almost entirely blank, so only the frame can be set out and nothing is estimated here. The data adjacent to this rising in the same month are these: in the first month of the ninth year of Dayi, on the day of ding-chou, 'an order was issued that the troops of the realm be assembled at Zhuojun'; 'men began to be recruited as xiaoguo'; 'the old forts of Liaodong were repaired to store military grain'; on the day of wu-hai in the same month, 'an amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm'. In the third month Meng Haigong of Jiyin rose as a bandit, 'holding the stronghold of Zhouqiao with a following of several tens of thousands'; at the same time the bandit chiefs of Shandong and Hebei 'each gathered bands of plunderers, the largest more than a hundred thousand and the smallest several thousand'; and the Qizhou assistant magistrate Zhang Xutuo broke Wang Bo's force below Mount Tai and again destroyed it at Linyi. In addition, the defeats in the Goguryeo wars are recorded in the histories as 'four or five in ten of the soldiers killed', a rate that shook the court; in the fifth month of the twelfth year of Dayi Su Wei described the source of the disorder as 'all of them turned into bandits'; in the same year Zhen Jie'er with a hundred thousand men ravaged Taiyuan and Pan Changwen was killed in defeat; toward the end of Dayi the 'slave-bandits' of Pingliang, several tens of thousands strong, surrounded Fufeng, did not take it 'for several months', and finally ran out of food; and in the first month of the first year of Wude the prefectures of Yulin, Lingwu, Pingliang and Anding all sent envoys to acknowledge Li Yuan. As for the actual strength, the territory held and the record of Bai Yusa's band, the official histories record nothing; the accounts conflict, and no estimated figure is given on this card.
cause: 白瑜娑起義的直接背景，是隋朝對高句麗的第三次大規模戰爭把整個西北邊地捲入徵發與消耗之中。煬帝自大業七年起兩度東征，大業九年正月再徵天下兵集涿郡、修築遼東古城貯糧，兵員、糧秣與牲畜的抽取遍及全國，而最重的一端正落在沿邊各州。靈州與涼州一帶的屯田與牧場是供應騎兵坐騎與軍馬的產地，馬匹被大批徵用、牧戶被抽丁，邊州的生計因此被直接切斷。制度層面的壓力同樣沉重：隋朝連年括戶、增收租調，律法對逃奴婢、逃戶與逃亡丁口課以重刑，走投無路者聚眾為盜，便被朝廷連同奴婢叛逃者一概貶稱「奴賊」。信任層面的破裂則來自朝廷的反覆：第一次征遼失敗並被突厥圍於雁門之後，隋廷曾許罷征遼，翌年卻再度徵發，蘇威在大業十二年指出「昔在雁門，許罷征遼，今復征發，賊何由息」——徵兵無度的結果，是承受「往日租賦丁役」之民「皆化為盜」。至於白瑜娑本人是本地屯戶、逃奴還是亡命將門，史料並未交代；可以確定的是，他選在隋朝防守最薄弱的西北邊州起事，而當地又正是被強徵與饑困驅使的人心最容易聚集之處。
causeEn: The immediate background to Bai Yusa's rising was that the third great Sui war against Goguryeo dragged the entire north-west frontier into conscription and exhaustion. Emperor Yang had marched east twice from the seventh year of Dayi, and in the first month of the ninth year he called up the troops of the realm once more to Zhuojun and built forts in Liaodong to store grain; the levy of men, provisions and animals was taken from the whole empire, and the heaviest end of it fell on the frontier prefectures. The tuntian fields and pastures of Lingzhou and Liangzhou supplied the mounts for the cavalry and the remounts for the army; when horses were taken away in bulk and herdsmen were conscripted, the livelihood of the border was cut at the root. The pressure of institutions was no lighter: the Sui carried out repeated household surveys and added to the land tax, and the legal code laid heavy penalties on runaway slaves, runaway households and men absconding from their households; those with nowhere to go gathered into bands and were then lumped by the court together with rebel slaves and called slave-bandits. Trust broke down as well, because the court kept breaking its own word: after the first campaign failed and the emperor was penned in at Yanmen by the Turks, the Sui had promised to call off the eastern war, yet levied it again the following year, and Su Wei pointed out in the twelfth year of Dayi that 'once at Yanmen it was promised that the eastern war would be called off; now it is levied again — how can the bandits ever end?' The result of endless conscription was that the people who had borne 'the taxes and the corvée of former days' 'all turned into bandits'. Whether Bai Yusa himself was a local tuntian household, a runaway slave or a fugitive of some officer's household is not stated in the sources; what can be established is that he rose in the north-west frontier, where the Sui's defence was thinnest and where hardship and conscription had gathered the most discontented men.
impact: 白瑜娑起義的影響，首先在戰略層面：劫掠牧馬與北連突厥，使隋朝西征與北御所需的家畜來源與邊境秩序同時受損，而這些正是第三次征高句麗最吃緊的資源。其次在政治層面，「奴賊」在隋末成為一種普遍而持久的亂軍形態：與他前後相近的楊玄感黎陽起義，旬日之間聚眾至數十萬，響應者多為奴婢、屯田戶與府戶；大業末年平涼的奴賊數萬能圍困扶風數月，說明這類武裝並非只在西北一隅。到武德元年正月，靈武、榆林、平涼、安定諸郡已各自遣使請命李淵，邊州的效忠對象由隋廷轉為唐室，白瑜娑所盤踞的地區也隨之被新朝的靈州都督府體系收編，隋代設於此的軍府、屯田與牧場改隸唐的邊軍編制。再次在長時段上，這場起義說明隋朝的崩解並非某一場戰役的結果，而是中央對邊州控制力失效、北方草原勢力趁勢介入、地方軍與流民自我武裝三者交疊的產物；此後唐初在靈州、涼州方向與突厥、吐谷渾的長期角力，源頭正落在白瑜娑北連突厥所打開的那個缺口上。
impactEn: The impact of Bai Yusa's rising came first on the strategic level: raiding the pastures and tying himself to the Turks damaged at once the supply of horses and the order of the frontier on which the Sui's war plans against Goguryeo depended, and these were exactly the resources the third campaign could least afford. Second, on the political level, the slave-bandit became in the late Sui a general and durable form of disorder: Yang Xiangan's rising at Liyang, close in time to Bai Yusa's, drew tens of thousands within ten days, mostly runaway slaves, tuntian households and registered households; and toward the end of Dayi the slave-bandits of Pingliang, tens of thousands strong, could surround Fufeng for months — such armed groups were clearly not confined to one corner of the north-west. By the first month of the first year of Wude the prefectures of Lingwu, Yulin, Pingliang and Anding had each sent envoys to acknowledge Li Yuan; the allegiance of the border had shifted from the Sui court to Li Yuan, and the region where Bai Yusa had operated was absorbed into the new dynasty's Lingzhou system, while the military offices, tuntian fields and pastures that the Sui had kept there passed under the organisation of the Tang frontier army. Third, in the longer term, the rising shows that the collapse of the Sui was not the outcome of a single battle but the product of three things overlapping: the failure of central control over the border prefectures, the intervention of the northern steppe powers at the moment of weakness, and the arming of the local and the displaced by themselves. The long contest between the early Tang and the Turks and the Tuyuhun along the Lingzhou and Liangzhou lines thus traces back to the breach opened here by Bai Yusa's northern ties with the Turks.
result: 就現存史料而言，白瑜娑起義沒有留下任何一場可考的會戰記錄。《資治通鑑》關於他的記載只有大業九年正月那一句，既無勝負，也無官軍處置的記載；此後他的名字在編年史中不再出現，其人去向、其眾解散的經過與是否曾被鎮壓，正史都沒有交代，諸說並存。可以確定的是三點。第一，613年正月起事爆發之時，隋廷的處置並未立即生效：同一條記載下，朝廷一面下詔徵天下兵集涿郡、募民為驍果，一面「赦天下」，忙於東征而無力西顧，叛眾因此得以在隴右與靈州之間持續游走。第二，白瑜娑的破壞力集中在「劫掠牧馬」與「北連突厥」兩點上，而這兩項恰恰是隋朝第三次征遼最需要的資源；這也解釋了為何《資治通鑑》把他的起事與山東、關中同時爆發的諸亂並列在同一年的記錄之中。第三，到大業十三年至武德元年之間，靈武、平涼、安定、榆林諸郡相繼脫離隋廷而向李淵請命，白瑜娑所擾動的邊州遂歸入唐朝的靈州體系。整體看，這是一場記載極少、卻真實改變了西北邊防格局的邊民叛亂：它沒有被平定，卻隨著隋室的覆亡而自然收束，其影響延續到唐初的北疆經營。
resultEn: As far as the surviving sources go, Bai Yusa's rising left no traceable record of a single pitched battle. The Tongjian says only the one sentence of the first month of 613, giving neither the outcome of any fighting nor any account of how the court dealt with him; after that his name no longer appears in the annals, and neither his fate, nor the dispersal of his band, nor whether he was ever put down is recorded in the official histories — the accounts conflict. Three things can be established. First, when the rising broke out in the first month of 613, the court's response did not take effect at once: in the very same entry the throne ordered the troops of the realm to Zhuojun and began recruiting xiaoguo, and at the same time proclaimed an amnesty, too absorbed by the eastern war to look west, so that the rebels were able to keep roaming between Longyou and Lingzhou. Second, the destructive force of Bai Yusa lay in two things — plundering the grazing herds and joining with the Turks to the north — and those were precisely the resources the third Goguryeo campaign could least do without; this also explains why the Tongjian places his revolt in the same year's record alongside the risings that broke out at the same time in Shandong and in Guanzhong. Third, between the thirteenth year of Dayi and the first year of Wude the prefectures of Lingwu, Pingliang, Anding and Yulin one after another left the Sui and acknowledged Li Yuan, so the border prefectures that Bai Yusa had disturbed passed into the Tang system of Lingzhou. Taken as a whole, this was a frontier revolt very thinly recorded that nonetheless genuinely changed the military geography of the north-west: it was never suppressed, but it ended by the natural dissolution of the Sui, and its effects ran on into the early Tang management of the northern border.
